item.name: NASA Get near-Earth objects by date range

request.name: NASA Get near-Earth objects by date range

description.content: Returns a list of near-Earth objects with closest approach dates within a given date range. Maximum range is 7 days.

query.description: Start date for the search (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.
End date for the search (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to 7 days after start.

response.name: Successful response

info.name: NASA NeoWs (Near Earth Object Web Service) API

description.content:
NeoWs is a RESTful web service for near-Earth asteroid information. Data is sourced from the NASA JPL Asteroid team. Users can search for asteroids based on closest approach date, look up specific asteroids, and browse the dataset.
